name: Maggran Earthbinder
summary: Maggran Earthbinder is a grizzled tauren veteran appointed by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof to lead the Horde encampment at Sun Rock Retreat. Hardened by a lifetime of brutal conflict, he oversees the defense of the craggy valleys of Stonetalon against ravenous beasts and aggressive harpy covens. Though wearied by countless battles, he remains a steadfast guardian of the settlement.

sections.title: A Veteran's Haven
sections.body: Maggran Earthbinder was sent into the Stonetalon Mountains by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof himself. A veteran of countless skirmishes and bloody campaigns, Maggran admits that age and violence have hardened his heart, stripping away the natural gentleness typical of his people. Sun Rock Retreat was meant to be both an outpost under his steady command and a place of respite, where warm winds and mountain sunshine might soothe his battle-worn spirit.

sections.title: Threats in the Crags
sections.body: Even in Stonetalon, Maggran finds little peace. As overseer of Sun Rock Retreat, he coordinates defense efforts against the Bloodfury harpies nesting in the peaks and marshals fighters to counter predatory perils across the crags. Having once survived an ambush by the giant spider Besseleth himself, Maggran holds no illusions about the deadly wilderness around them and frequently enlists travelers to eliminate deadly regional predators before they overrun the outpost.

faq.answer: Maggran Earthbinder is the commanding tauren elder at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. Hardened by countless battles, he was stationed here by Cairne Bloodhoof to watch over the settlement and keep its supply roads and borders secure.

faq.q: Why was Maggran sent to Sun Rock Retreat?
faq.answer: Cairne Bloodhoof appointed him to lead Sun Rock Retreat partly for his seasoned military leadership and partly as a retreat. Maggran's body and soul have been heavily worn by a lifetime of combat, and the quiet mountain sun offers him a measure of healing.

faq.q: What threats does Maggran ask adventurers to deal with?
faq.answer: Maggran directs defense efforts against the savage Bloodfury harpies infesting the mountains and sends warriors to eliminate the giant spider matriarch Besseleth, a terrifying predator he narrowly escaped earlier in his travels.

faq.q: What happened between Maggran and Besseleth?
faq.answer: Maggran was previously ambushed and ensnared by the colossal spider Besseleth. Though he managed to break free and escape with his life, he sends capable adventurers to slay the beast so no one else falls victim to her web.

faq.q: Does Maggran have a role in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Maggran serves directly at the behest of Thunder Bluff's High Chieftain, Cairne Bloodhoof. While stationed out in the field at Sun Rock Retreat, his authority and orders stem straight from the capital.

faq.q: Is Maggran Earthbinder friendly to Alliance players?
faq.answer: No. Maggran is a staunch leader of the Horde and remains fully hostile to any Alliance adventurers who stumble into Sun Rock Retreat.

angles.text: Maggran embodies the heavy toll warfare takes on the shu'halo spirit, serving as a reminder of how conflict can harden even the most grounded children of the Earth Mother.
For travelers navigating the steep climbs of Stonetalon, Maggran is the primary authority coordinating local Horde patrols and keeping supply routes clear of beasts and harpies.
